restaurant.name: ALIXAN FAST FOOD
restaurant.address: Samarqand viloyati, Kattaqo'rg'on shahri, Alixan Fast Food (Cafe)

products.name: Hot-Dog (kusok nonga)
products.desc: Maxsus non, sersuv sosiska, marinadlangan bodring, maydalangan karam, sabzi-salat, klassik mayonez va ketchup.

products.name: Hot-Dog (yarimta nonga)
products.desc: Grill qilingan yarimta xushbo'y non, sersuv qovurilgan sosiska, marinadlangan bodring, maydalangan karam, sabzi-salat, pishloq sousi, mayonez va ketchup.

products.name: Hot-Dog (butun nonga)
products.desc: Grill qilingan butun non, 2 ta sersuv sosiska, marinadlangan bodring, maydalangan karam, sabzi-salat, mayonez va pomidor sousi.

products.name: Hot-Dog (Pishloqli Double)
products.desc: Grill qilingan non, 2 ta qovurilgan sosiska, erigan pishloq (cheddar), marinadlangan qarsildoq bodring, karam, sabzi-salat, maxsus pishloqli sous va ketchup.

products.name: Hot-Dog (katta MAX)
products.desc: Katta maxsus non, 3 ta sersuv sosiska, marinadlangan bodring, karam, sabzi-salat, ko'p pishloq, mayonez va Alixan maxsus sousi.

products.name: Hot-Dog (Mega Alixan)
products.desc: Katta non, 4 ta sosiska, ikki barobar erigan pishloq, qarsildoq bodring, sabzavotlar va Alixan maxsus firmenniy souslari.

products.name: Tandir Lavash (Standart)
products.desc: Tandirda yopilgan kunjutli qarsildoq xamir, sersuv mol go'shti (doner), yangi pomidor, bodring, qarsildoq chips va maxsus oq-qizil sous.

products.name: Tandir Lavash (Pishloqli)
products.desc: Kunjutli tandir xamiri, mo'l mol go'shti, erigan pishloq (mozzarella), yangi pomidor va bodring, chips hamda mayin pishloq sousi.

products.name: Tandir Lavash (Double Go'sht)
products.desc: Katta tandir xamiri, 2 barobar ko'p sarxil mol go'shti, pishloq, yangi sabzavotlar, chips va Alixan maxsus firmenniy sousi.

products.name: Tandir Lavash (Mega Gigant)
products.desc: Oila va do'stlar uchun ulkan (3-4 kishilik) tandir lavash: nihoyatda mo'l mol go'shti, qo'shaloq erigan pishloq, sabzavotlar, chips va boy souslar jamlanmasi.

products.name: Tovuqli Tandir Lavash (Standart)
products.desc: Kunjutli tandir xamiri, marinadlangan sersuv tovuq filesi, yangi pomidor, bodring, qarsildoq chips va maxsus sarimsoqli oq sous.

products.name: Tovuqli Tandir Lavash (Pishloqli)
products.desc: Kunjutli tandir xamiri, sersuv tovuq filesi, erigan mozzarella pishlog'i, yangi pomidor, bodring, chips va pishloqli mayin sous.

products.name: Tovuqli Tandir Lavash (Double Tovuq)
products.desc: Katta tandir xamiri, 2 hissa ko'p tovuq go'shti, erigan pishloq, sabzavotlar, qarsildoq chips va Alixan maxsus firmenniy sousi.

products.name: Burger (1 ta kotletli)
products.desc: Mayin kunjutli bulochka, 1 ta sersuv mol go'shti kotleti, erigan cheddar pishlog'i, yangi pomidor, qizil piyoz, yangi salat bargi va maxsus burger sousi.

products.name: Burger (2 ta kotletli)
products.desc: Kunjutli bulochka, 2 ta katta sersuv mol go'shti kotleti, ikki qavat erigan cheddar pishlog'i, yangi pomidor, aysberg salat bargi, qizil piyoz va maxsus Alixan sousi.

products.name: Burger Tovuqli (1 ta kotletli)
products.desc: Kunjutli mayin bulochka, 1 ta qarsildoq qovurilgan tovuq kotleti (file), yangi pomidor, yangi salat bargi va mayin mayonezli sous.

products.name: Burger Tovuqli (2 ta kotletli)
products.desc: Kunjutli bulochka, 2 ta qarsildoq tovuq kotleti, yangi sersuv pomidor, aysberg salat bargi va maxsus oq sous.

products.name: Donar (kusok nonga)
products.desc: Grill qilingan qarsildoq maxsus non, sarxil qovurilgan mol go'shti (doner), yangi pomidor va bodring, maydalangan karam, sarimsoqli oq sous va pomidor sousi.

products.name: Donar (yarimta nonga)
products.desc: Katakli grill qilingan yarimta non, sersuv mol go'shti (doner), yangi pomidor va bodring, maydalangan karam, qizil va oq sous.

products.name: Donar (Pishloqli)
products.desc: Katakli grill non, mol go'shti, erigan mozzarella pishlog'i, yangi pomidor, bodring, karam va mayin pishloq sousi.

products.name: Donar (Double Go'sht)
products.desc: Katta grill non, ikki hissa ko'p sersuv mol go'shti, erigan pishloq, yangi sabzavotlar va Alixan maxsus sousi.

products.name: Kartoshka Fri
products.desc: Oltinrang qovurilgan qarsildoq sifatli kartoshka somonchalari, yengil tuz va tomatli ketchup sousi.

products.name: KFC (Standart Basket)
products.desc: Maxsus unli panirovkada qovurilgan qarsildoq tovuq bo'laklari (oyoqcha va qanotlar), maxsus sous bilan.

products.name: KFC (Medium Basket)
products.desc: Sersuv va qarsildoq tovuq bo'laklari (qanotcha, strips, oyoqchalar) hamda 2 xil sarxil sous.

products.name: KFC (Large Basket)
products.desc: Katta tovuqli boks: qarsildoq qanotlar, oyoqchalar va stripslar hamda souslar to'plami.

products.name: KFC (Mega Family)
products.desc: Oila va katta do'stlar davrasi uchun ulkan basket: eng ko'p qarsildoq tovuq bo'laklari (strips, qanot, oyoqchalar) va to'liq souslar to'plami.

products.name: Chiken (Standart)
products.desc: Yumshoq pita noni (cho'ntakcha), qovurilgan mayin tovuq filesi, yangi pomidor, bodring, aysberg salat bargi, qizil piyoz va oq sarimsoqli sous.

products.name: Chiken (Pishloqli)
products.desc: Pita noni, sersuv tovuq go'shti, erigan pishloq, yangi pomidor, bodring, salat bargi va mayin sous.

products.name: Chiken (Double Tovuq)
products.desc: Katta pita noni, ikki hissa ko'p sersuv tovuq filesi, pishloq, yangi pomidor, bodring, piyoz va Alixan maxsus sousi.

products.name: Chiken (MAX Alixan)
products.desc: Maksimal to'yimli: mo'l qovurilgan tovuq go'shti, qo'shaloq pishloq, yangi sabzavotlar va boy firmenniy souslar jamlanmasi.

products.name: Pitsa Kolbasali
products.desc: Italyancha qarsildoq xamir, sarxil dudlangan sifatli kolbasa (pepperoni), erigan mozzarella pishlog'i, zaytun (maslina), tomat sousi va oregano.

products.name: Pitsa Tovuqli
products.desc: Pechda pishirilgan xushbo'y xamir, grill tovuq filesi bo'laklari, yangi shampinon qo'ziqorinlari, shirin makkajo'xori, bulg'or qalampiri, mozzarella pishlog'i va pizza sousi.

products.name: Pitsa Go'shtli
products.desc: Maxsus tandir xamiri, grill mol go'shti (file va qiyma), yashil bulg'or qalampiri, qizil piyoz, ko'p erigan mozzarella pishlog'i va boy pomidor sousi.

products.name: Pitsa Assorti
products.desc: Barcha sevimli ta'mlar birida: dudlangan kolbasa, sarxil mol go'shti, mayin tovuq filesi, shampinon qo'ziqorinlari, shirin makkajo'xori, bulg'or qalampiri, zaytun, mo'l mozzarella pishlog'i va pizza sousi.

products.name: Coca-Cola
products.desc: Muzdek, tetiklantiruvchi klassik gazlangan ichimlik.

products.name: Pepsi
products.desc: Muzdek, xushbo'y va tetiklantiruvchi klassik Pepsi.

products.name: Fanta
products.desc: Apelsin ta'mli, tetiklantiruvchi yorqin salqin ichimlik.
